title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.7.8
subtitle: Accurate Gaia runtime details in the Bake Companion.

highlights.title: See the real backend
highlights.description: Gaia now reports its verified CUDA, CPU, or ROCm runtime and device instead of displaying protocol metadata as the backend.

highlights.title: Follow live solver telemetry
highlights.description: Expanded Solver details show only timing, assembly, solve, advancement, memory, and stretch values actually reported by the active solver.

highlights.title: Expand only what is there
highlights.description: Unavailable rows stay hidden, expanded height follows visible content, and collapsing returns to the exact existing Bake Companion size.
